name: lvx_msgbox_create

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-11-4.100.155 IDB: lvx_page_msgbox.c create: class-creates the msgbox object (class table whose destructor is lvx_page_msgbox_destructor), hooks the page event through add_event_to_page when a page is given, registers it on the msgbox list and returns it. 0xc50fdbc is the (parent, page) wrapper that calls the constructor 0xc50fd30 with flag 0; 0xc50fdb0 is the flag-1 sibling.

notes: Address corrected by EVID-UI-4155-MSGBOX-001; the earlier CANDIDATE address was a different function. Target-private UI host use only; device probe pending. Device verified for the UI host (EVID-UI-4155-DEVICE-001); policy stays restricted.
